newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH INDUSTRY'S PROFITABILITY TO RISE - TT SURVEY.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH INDUSTRY'S PROFITABILITY TO RISE - TT SURVEY.

text.p: Finnish industry's cyclical expectations are improving as production growth will strengthen and profitability improve, the Confederation of Finnish Industry and Employers (TT) said on Thursday.
"One year from now, industry's profitability is expected to be better than now," it said, referring to a survey of member companies, the so called TT cyclical barometer, made in January.
The forest industry's production and exports expectations are favourable. The fall in profitability has slowed and a year from now, profitability would be "clearly better" than currently, TT said.
In the metal industry, the pace of output growth has accelerated and exports are on the rise. Profitability is expected to go on improving steadily but not very strongly, TT said.
(NOTE - The Finnish metal industry comprises metal, engineering and electrotechnical production). --Helsinki Newsroom +358 - 9 - 680 50 245
